name: bffi-example-event-loop
description: Example bffi-rs native module: the event-loop surface (enqueue/pump drain, marshal, blocking run on a worker thread, sticky stop) consumed through the @z2net/bffi pipeline. @z2net/bffi resolves via the root tsconfig paths inside this monorepo; in a standalone project use `bun add @z2net/bffi`.
